instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the circular pocket pattern and raised center pads from the supplied sketches. Use Sketch001 to create the pocket cut with a 5 mm length setting, centered on the sketch plane, then repeat it in a 360 degree Polar Pattern with 8 occurrences as shown. Use Sketch002 to create the lower raised center pad with a 20 mm height, centered on the sketch plane. Use Sketch003 to create the upper raised center pad with a 40 mm height, centered on the sketch plane. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
